findings.probe: Executed actual staging control flow with fs writes/copies and subprocesses stubbed; observed recursive data and output/reports copies; no staging created.

findings.meaning: Existing cleanup targets png/log/pyc/tmp/temp only; JSON snapshots remain outside its removal plan.
Package excludes retired readings while legacy test requires MD2-MD4 registries/projections unconditionally; observed failure earlier in current chat.

recommendation: Avoid copying historical output/reports into each staging; limit staged inputs without changing canonical forecasting rules.
Introduce shared compressed snapshot storage with audit readers that transparently decode it, preserving exact original data.
Make cleanup and package tests obey the same retirement/retention policy.
Measure current audit evidence before setting an output budget; 200-500 MB was not a validated estimate.
